openCourses.title: OpenStory Studio: Professional Instructional Design and Development
openCourses.imageAlt: OpenStory Studio course artwork showing a branching path toward learning resources and media
openCourses.summary: A self-paced English studio for designing, building, and publishing interactive learning experiences with OpenStory.
openCourses.detail: Includes 16 foundations modules, narrated screen tutorials, an integrated scenario-design case, and four portfolio milestones. Learners move from a design brief and storyboard to an accessible interactive prototype and a SCORM 1.2 release candidate for Moodle.

openCourses.title: Designing Adaptive Learning Environments
openCourses.subtitle: Interaction, Personalization, and Analytics
openCourses.imageAlt: DALE course artwork of a learner moving along colorful stepping stones and connected learning data
openCourses.summary: A 15-module course on designing adaptive learning experiences through interaction, personalization, and learning analytics.
openCourses.detail: Learners design, build, and evaluate an adaptive learning prototype with an analytics plan. The course combines readings, videos, design activities, and a culminating project for graduate learners and practitioners.

openCourses.title: Simulation-Based Learning and Immersive Technologies
openCourses.imageAlt: SBL course artwork of a paper collage with an immersive learning studio and virtual reality headset
openCourses.summary: A 15-module course connecting the learning science of simulation with the design and evaluation of immersive experiences.
openCourses.detail: Learners develop a simulation or immersive learning prototype, examine guidance and debriefing, and prepare a package for reuse. The course serves graduate learners and practitioners using free or open-source tools.

plannedCourses.summary: A planned course exploring AI-supported feedback and formative assessment.
plannedCourses.detail: Course development is planned. A syllabus and access information will be added when available.
